caption: The drawing depicts a circular sundial with a gray metallic appearance, featuring Roman numerals and concentric rings on its face. The plate is supported vertically by two upright wooden posts, which are colored in a light brown shade, and these posts are connected by a rectangular wooden base, also colored brown. A slender, slightly lighter gray rod (the gnomon) projects perpendicularly from the top center of the sundial face, casting a shadow to indicate time. The main sundial illustration is centered within a rectangular border in the upper part of the drawing. Below this central image, three smaller technical sketches are arranged horizontally: the leftmost sketch shows a simplified front view of the sundial with some measurements; the middle sketch presents a side or top-down profile of the sundial showing its curvature; the rightmost sketch depicts a side view of the assembled sundial and supporting structure, including angular measurements. The overall background of the drawing is an off-white or cream color, providing contrast for the gray and brown tones used in the diagram and technical drawings.
title: Sun Dial
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
